description:
🚀 We are Project Zenith, a team of enthusiastic students interested in space exploration, technology, AI, and game development. We love creativity, teamwork, and turning ideas into reality.

Join us to learn, collaborate, experiment, and build something exciting for the NASA Space Apps Challenge!

Looking for: Python programmers, game/web developers, AI/ML enthusiasts, UI/UX designers, space research enthusiasts, and creative thinkers.​
